sentences.en: His lack of technical knowledge kept him from being promoted.
sentences.zh: 由于缺乏技术知识，他未能晋升。

sentences.en: You need technical knowledge to understand how this system works.
sentences.zh: 要理解这个系统的工作原理，你需要具备技术知识。

sentences.en: Clearness should be a guiding principle of every technical writer.
sentences.zh: 清晰性应该是每个技术人员遵循的原则之一。
